results.title: Stanford football players reach key threshold on path to college player unionization
results.description: The momentum for collective bargaining within college athletics took another leap this week. A group of Stanford University football players are establishing the first-ever chapter of the College Football Players Association in a move intended to create a foundation for eventual unionization and collective bargaining, the association and players announced Monday. results.title: CWG 2026: India’s relay specialist Rajesh Ramesh eyes strong Games debut
